summary: Garden Stage Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its extraordinary general meeting held August 26, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$1,000,000 (expanding Class A from 2,453,750 to 49,953,750 shares), adoption of third amended and restated memorandum and articles of association, authorization of transfer agent actions, and potential adjournment. Votes were overwhelmingly in favor, with 925,014,508 shares represented (99.84% voting power). This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic actions were disclosed.
